name: Astoria
summary: The oldest American settlement west of the Rockies, at the mouth of the Columbia — a hilltop column, Lewis and Clark's winter fort, and 'Goonies' nostalgia.

lodging.name: A riverfront Astoria hotel
lodging.blurb: Watch the ships on the Columbia.

foodMustTry.name: Fresh Columbia River salmon
foodMustTry.blurb: And a pint in a riverfront brewery.

days.label: Day 490 — Column, Maritime & the Goonies
days.summary: The river town and its history.

item.title: The Astoria Column & Maritime Museum
item.blurb: Climb the painted column for the river view, then the excellent Columbia River Maritime Museum down on the waterfront.

item.title: Fort Clatsop (Lewis & Clark NHP)
item.blurb: The reconstructed fort where Lewis and Clark wintered in 1805–06.

item.title: The Oregon Film Museum & Goonies Astoria
item.blurb: The museum is in the old Clatsop County Jail, which is the jail the Fratellis break out of in the first two minutes of The Goonies — you can film your own escape in the cells. Astoria has done well out of the movies: Kindergarten Cop, Free Willy and Short Circuit were all shot here. The Goonies house is up on 38th Street and is privately owned, so admire it from the road.

days.label: Day 491 — Across to Washington
days.summary: Over the Columbia to the volcano.

commute.scenicNote: North across the great river bridge into Washington.
